Also, even after classes were done, he didn’t ask for money. It’s me who is behind him asking for hisab so I can pay timely.

Rare are such species in the today’s world.

Thank you both Rajesh uncle and Jay!

featured_reviews.name: meta burner
featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually never write critiqued reviews of businesses/restaurants because I truly believe that business owners continue to try and do their very best in overcoming their shortcomings. However the experience I’ve had with this motor training school (especially the instructor) has compelled me to write a lengthy review. I joined this training school to learn driving for a manual car transmission for around 20 days with each session supposed to last for 25-30 mins. Firstly, I faced a lot of scheduling issues, their drivers weren’t free most slots and as a result I had to wait a prolonged period of time (around 3-4 weeks) before I could actually get started. Secondly, before I joined, I asked for a trial class to see if this school was my best fit but they refused that and asked me to pay the full advance amount and only then they would go ahead with scheduling.
Coming to the actual teaching part, the instructor barely took the effort to teach anything. He controlled the car entirely via the clutch/brake present on the passenger’s side and even turned the steering wheel for me at times, never took the car above the 3rd gear even on empty roads, took the same 10 min route almost everyday (which had 0 traffic by the way so I didn’t learn how to navigate through high traffic areas like most areas in Mumbai are). The clutch/break present on the passenger’s side is there to prevent accidents but this driving instructor was using it to completely control the car to get away from the responsibility of actually teaching the student. As a result I learnt absolutely nothing and when I went to drive my own car, I was absolutely clueless on the works of the clutch since the instructor had been controlling practically everything. Secondly, the class was supposed to last for 25 mins but he would take it for only 15 mins, and hence would have to ask him to take it for a little longer every time. Sometimes he would refuel the car in the middle of my session which would waste precious time (he wouldn’t even compensate the time lost while he was refuelling) while he could’ve easily done the refuelling before my class or after. He would also randomly take holidays and would inform on the day of (5-10 mins before the session) that he can’t come. He didn’t teach anything that was slightly more difficult such as parking which is very important when learning to drive. I paid around 7500 to learn to drive an Ertiga but when around 1-2 sessions were left, the instructor asked for “gurudakshina” which was extra from the normal fees. If he would’ve taught properly and if I would’ve learned something from him, then paying the gurudakshina would have made sense but here it was totally unnecessary.  All he “taught” was taking a U-turn and reversing the car to take a turn. Just when I thought this couldn’t get any worse, the staff here are just as pathetic as the instructor. I was due to get my main license right after I had learnt driving from the school and I kept calling the staff for around 3 months to schedule the appointment and each time they would say they are going to book it and they never did. I would’ve have just booked it myself but I had already done my learner’s license through this school so had to get my main license also from here. Finally after literally months of calling them, they finally scheduled my appointment. Here’s the only good part out of their entire service- they took us to and from the RTO office in Wadala for the driving test and handled all the paperwork. Overall, a big no for this driving school and I had a horrible experience here. Ended up having to hire a driver privately and pay him too in order to teach me which in total costed me almost double to learn driving. Would definitely NOT recommend this place- there are much better driving schools (and cheaper ones) in the city.
